g.text: Benchmarking wkv & wbftree against mainstream embedded databases
Key/Value Spec：24B Key / 150B Value, simulating typical binary UUIDs / compact
indexed keys and structured or serialized payloads.
Cache Budget：Uniformly budgeted at 128 MiB, constraining Block Cache, Buffer
Pool, and Write Buffer (MemTable) across all engines.
Workload Scale：6,000,000 records (~1.04 GiB raw writes), physical disk footprint
is 10~30x larger than memory cache to thoroughly stress cache eviction and
Write Scenarios：Individual writes test single-op durability latency; batch
(1,000/batch) and async writes benchmark max ingestion throughput.
Read Benchmarks：100,000 point lookups and 5,000 range scans (step 10), multi-threaded
reads (4~32 threads), reporting median of 3 runs.
Disk & Memory：Disk usage measures physical database file size pre/post compaction;
memory records final OS resident physical memory (RSS / Footprint) before
Performance metrics display relative multiplier in the first line (baseline
1.00X for lowest performance, higher is better) and disk throughput in the
second line. Random reads and range scans report median of 3 runs. Cache
sizes are configured uniformly where applicable.
